span.p:
report() classifies, starts the SLA and
asks the assignment strategy at once.
It stays CLASSIFIED only if no skilled
technician has free capacity.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
addNote (assigned Technician) is allowed
in ACKNOWLEDGED and IN_PROGRESS.
It adds a note and an audit record
but does not change the status.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Nothing is allowed. A note on a closed
incident gets "Cannot add a note while
the incident is CLOSED".
